evidence.claim: Communication services -12.25% in Oct, worst sector; Meta/Alphabet -30% from highs on capex-sentiment panic
evidence.relation: rotation outflow + capex sentiment -> short-term drag

evidence.source: Adam Khoo — Hyperscalers Crash After Earnings (Oct 30)
evidence.claim: Capex fear is growth capex: GOOGL rev +25%/op income +30%; META op income +11% ex one-off fine; negative FCF driven by one-offs (EU fine, TPU inventory cash returning 2027)
evidence.relation: growth capex -> future earnings up; drop is sentiment not fundamentals

evidence.source: Adam Khoo — My Stock Market Q4 Game Plan (Oct 14)
evidence.claim: Consumer AI agents (Meta News/Muse app — #1 on both US stores; ChatGPT 'Dots') route purchases through agents instead of humans: ad-funded search marketplaces lose (display ads become worthless to agents), middlemen get disintermediated (Booking retains inventory moat but Tripadvisor/Upwork/Fiverr and non-diversified platforms like Snap/Pinterest/Reddit are at structural risk)
evidence.relation: agentic disintermediation → advertising-revenue erosion for ad-funded platforms

resolution: Direct conflict (short-term flow out vs fundamentals intact). Resolution: fundamentals argument applies on a quarters horizon; our 90-day view is dominated by the Fed-hike leg (72%) and the observed outflow — bearish stance kept for the current window; revisit in Q1-2027 when the inventory cash returns and hike risk rolls off. The Oct-14 agentic-disintermediation claim adds a structural (180d half-life) down-leg against the ad-funded members, reinforcing the bearish stance for this window beyond the short-term flow leg.
